claim: Step Functions can include human approval steps in the workflow (human in the loop). In the AWS example, a callback and a task token make Step Functions wait until a person confirms, and then the workflow continues.

evidence.quote: Human in the loop – Step Functions can include human approval steps in the workflow.

With [a callback and a task token](connect-to-resource.md#connect-wait-token), you can have Step Functions wait until the customers friend confirms the transfer, and then Step Functions will continue the workflow to notify the banking customer that the transfer has completed.
